templates.name: Blank stack
templates.description: An empty compose file with the fleet conventions in comments.
templates.compose:
# New stack — a file in this repo is the source of truth.
# deploy.py / Homelab Console push this to /opt/stacks/<name>/.
#
# Exposure rule: publish on loopback only; put a vhost in this host's
# Caddyfile if humans need a name for it.
services:
  example:
    image: nginx:1.29.0
    container_name: example
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8088:80"

templates.name: Whoami (diagnostic)
templates.description: Tiny HTTP echo service — useful to prove push + recreate end to end.
templates.compose:
# whoami — disposable diagnostic endpoint on loopback :9180.
services:
  whoami:
    image: traefik/whoami:v1.11.0
    container_name: whoami
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:9180:80"

templates.name: Uptime Kuma
templates.description: Self-hosted uptime monitor. Data lives at /srv/uptime-kuma.
templates.compose:
# Uptime Kuma — loopback :3001, front it with Caddy if wanted.
services:
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1.23.16
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - /srv/uptime-kuma:/app/data

templates.name: Dozzle (log viewer)
templates.description: Container log viewer. Read-only docker socket mount; loopback :9999.
templates.compose:
# Dozzle — loopback :9999. The docker socket is powerful: keep this local.
services:
  dozzle:
    image: amir20/dozzle:v8.12.8
    container_name: dozzle
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:9999:8080"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
